summary: Built a 3-member etcd v3.5.17 cluster (node1, node2, node3) on RHEL 9 via systemd units with static bootstrap, opened firewalld ports 2379/2380. Verified cross-node read/write replication, tolerance of a single-member outage with continued reads/writes, and catch-up sync of the returning member. Completed the mandatory sequential restart protocol on all three nodes: captured boot_id + etcd health baseline, issued native `reboot`, polled until reachable again, confirmed changed boot_id, and verified etcd auto-restarted with full cluster/raft sync before proceeding to the next node.
actions_performed: Installed etcd v3.5.17 binaries (etcd, etcdctl, etcdutl) on node1/node2/node3 from official GitHub release tarball
Configured /etc/hosts and dedicated etcd system user + data dir on each node
Created systemd unit /etc/systemd/system/etcd.service on each node with static 3-member initial-cluster config
Opened firewalld ports 2379/2380 (tcp) on all three nodes
Started etcd on all nodes and confirmed 3-member healthy cluster formed
Wrote a key via node1 and confirmed it was readable from node2 and node3 (replication)

Stopped etcd on node3, confirmed writes/reads still succeeded via node1/node2 quorum, restarted node3 and confirmed it caught up (matching raft applied index) and could read data written during its outage
Executed mandatory restart protocol: captured boot_id + etcd active status + data readability baseline on all 3 nodes
Rebooted node1 (quorum preserved by node2/node3, verified write during outage), polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id, verified etcd auto-started and fully synced
Rebooted node2 (quorum preserved by node1/node3, verified write during outage), polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id, verified etcd auto-started, resynced, and new leader elected

Rebooted node3 (quorum preserved by node1/node2, verified write during outage), polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id, verified etcd auto-started, resynced, and cluster fully healthy with all raft indices matching

evidence.requirement: Unavailable member catches up when it returns
evidence.summary: Restarted node3 etcd; it read the key written during its outage and endpoint status shows matching raft applied index 15 across all three members

evidence.summary: Captured node1 boot_id 6aa805ba... and confirmed etcd active + data readable

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: changed boot identity proven
evidence.summary: Connection timed out mid-reboot, then node1 responded with new boot_id 102763c9... (different from baseline)
etcd active, during-outage key readable, all 3 endpoints synced at raft applied index 16

etcd active on node2, during-node2-outage key readable, all 3 endpoints synced at raft applied index 19, new leader elected (node3)
